caption: Uruguay ❤️ Bosnia and Herzegovina: waterfront hugs, warm courtyards, copper ateliers and river-window embraces. Four fictional adult friends in sculpted minis, varied heels and rainbow accents. AI fashion. #WorldXXXSeries #InternalAgency

altChecks.alt: AI-generated Uruguay-inspired fashion editorial of four fictional adult women sharing a gentle hug and handclasp in a waterfront window lounge. The seated braided woman wears a pearl-white mini with blue seams; a blonde companion wears a blue-and-white sun-motif dress. Two companions wear navy with pearl lines and silver with turquoise piping. A GRD upper-arm tattoo and rainbow legwear are visible. The water and skyline are fictional scenery.

AI-generated Uruguay-inspired fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a warm stone courtyard lounge. A braided woman and a blonde woman share a smiling side hug; one companion sits on a padded stone bench while another leans in beside her. Blue-and-white sun-motif garments contrast with ivory and copper and deep teal. Visible footwear includes terracotta sandals, ivory boots and dark green platform boots. Tattoos and a strip of rainbow hosiery complete the styling.

AI-generated Bosnia and Herzegovina-inspired fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a window atelier. A blonde woman in ivory and copper gives a smiling back hug to a seated braided woman in metallic copper. A cobalt-clad companion reaches for her hand while a fourth in navy with gold seams leans forward. Copper pumps, ivory platforms, blue ankle boots, rainbow hosiery and a GRD upper-arm tattoo are visible. Tiled market roofs beyond the glass are fictional scenery.

AI-generated Bosnia and Herzegovina-inspired fashion scene with four fictional adult women in a river-window lounge. A braided woman in a blue, yellow and white star-patterned mini reclines against a blonde companion in pale gold and blue. A woman in pearl and teal crouches beside them, while a fourth in deep teal sits on a higher padded seat. Rainbow ankle boots, teal knee-high boots and varied heels complete the styling. A stone-arch bridge and turquoise river outside form an imagined backdrop.
